articles.title: Supreme Court Says Border Wall Work Can Go On in West Texas
articles.summary: The Supreme Court said border wall work in west Texas can continue while the court case goes on, clearing the way for building in the Big Bend area, including Big Bend National Park.

articles.title: Ukraine Peace Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi
articles.summary: Ukraine, Russia, and the United States have begun new talks in Abu Dhabi about ending the war, with the future of eastern Ukraine and postwar security at the center of the discussion.

articles.title: A Plan to Swap Land Stirs Debate on Cumberland Island
articles.summary: The National Park Service wants to swap parkland on Georgia's Cumberland Island for private land, a plan that would allow up to eight new homes and has split islanders, conservationists, and the Carnegie family.
